# Next Audio
Next Audio is a podcast and digital audio advertising company.
We help brands and agencies plan, buy, and scale podcast advertising as a proper, measurable media channel.
We are not a platform. We do not sell inventory. We make podcast advertising actually work.
## Who We Serve
- Agency media planners at regional and global agencies
- Direct brand marketers in e-commerce, fintech, travel, and telco
## Markets
- MENA / GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Egypt) — primary
- Europe (Luxembourg and broader EU)
- Latin America
- Asia Pacific (via SiriusXM partnership)
## Network
- 55,000+ podcasts
- 850+ campaigns delivered
- 350+ active brands and agencies
- 90+ global markets
## Key Partnerships
- SiriusXM (preferred partner for MENA and APAC)
- AdsWizz (technology infrastructure)
- Measurement: IAB, Barometer, Podscribe
## Services
- Managed Campaigns: full-service execution from $10K
- AdManager: self-serve platform
- Host-Read Studio: creator marketplace for host-read sponsorships
